summary:
Earth Trend Detective is an interactive web application that transforms complex NASA climate data into an accessible and engaging learning experience.

Using NASA's MERRA-2 atmospheric reanalysis dataset, the project explores 20 years of temperature patterns (2005–2024) across all 11 Southeast Asian countries. It processes real climate data to calculate annual average temperatures, temperature anomalies, and estimated warming or cooling trends.

Built with Python, FastAPI, React, and TypeScript, the platform allows users to explore individual countries, compare historical temperature patterns, visualize climate trends, and investigate five interactive questions that encourage evidence-based reasoning.

The project aims to bridge the gap between scientific datasets and everyday understanding, making Earth science more approachable for students, educators, and curious citizens.

AI tools assisted with software development, debugging, and documentation, but all climate observations originate from NASA MERRA-2 data, not AI-generated values. Scientific limitations are acknowledged to promote transparency and responsible interpretation.

Our mission: Making Earth science more accessible, interactive, and understandable, one question at a time.
details:
Earth Trend Detective - Project Details

Earth Trend Detective is an interactive climate exploration platform designed to make NASA Earth science data more accessible, understandable, and engaging, particularly for students, educators, and curious citizens.

How It Works

The project uses NASA's MERRA-2 atmospheric reanalysis dataset to investigate temperature patterns across all 11 Southeast Asian countries from 2005 to 2024.

We processed 240 months of real NASA data using Python, converting raw NetCDF files into structured datasets. Country-level temperatures were calculated using geographic boundary polygons and geodesic area-weighted grid-cell intersections. The application presents annual average temperatures, temperature anomalies, and estimated temperature trends through interactive visualizations.

Users can select countries, explore different time periods, download datasets, and answer five interactive climate investigation questions.

Technology and Tools

The application uses a hybrid architecture:

  • Python: Scientific data processing and analysis.
  • FastAPI: Backend API for delivering climate observations.
  • React and TypeScript: Interactive frontend and data visualizations.
  • NASA Earthdata Harmony: Accessing MERRA-2 climate datasets.
  • NetCDF4, NumPy, Xarray, Shapely, and PyProj: Scientific and geospatial processing.
  • GeoJSON: Geographic boundaries for Southeast Asian countries.
  • Git and GitHub: Version control and source code management.

AI tools, including ChatGPT, assisted with planning, coding, debugging, and documentation. However, no synthetic or AI-generated climate observations were used.

Creativity and Innovation

Rather than simply displaying climate statistics, Earth Trend Detective encourages users to become climate investigators.

Its five interactive questions transform passive data visualization into an evidence-based learning experience. Users can explore geographic differences, compare temperature trends, and discover how climate patterns vary across Southeast Asia.

Benefits and Intended Impact

Our goal is to bridge the gap between complex scientific datasets and everyday understanding.

Earth Trend Detective aims to promote climate literacy, encourage critical thinking, support STEM education, and make NASA's scientific resources more approachable to people without specialized technical knowledge.

Challenges and Considerations

During development, we prioritized scientific transparency, reproducibility, usability, and responsible AI usage.

We considered the limitations of MERRA-2's coarse spatial resolution, incomplete geographic coverage for Myanmar, and Singapore's representation by a single grid cell. We also recognize that estimated temperature trends over a 20-year period should not be interpreted as definitive long-term climate conclusions without independent validation.

Ultimately, Earth Trend Detective transforms real NASA data into an interactive opportunity to explore, question, and better understand our changing planet.
